why_next: This experiment attempted to correct the parent V1 confound (error-body hashing, r=0.375) by switching to headers-only structural signal extraction. The error-body correlation was eliminated but a new V1 confound was introduced: request_id differs by token state (UUID 36-char for valid vs token_hex 16-hex for expired, entropy p=2.7e-34). The B-FLASK-ONLY baseline was built without token validation, producing degenerate zero behavioral variance (r=NaN). Both issues are correctable. The production-like testbed infrastructure (CDN simulation, PyJWT RS256, SQLite WAL, 3 endpoints, 304 rate 31.7%) remains sound and reusable. The frozen decision_rule C1-C6 can be reused. The orthogonality question remains the highest-upside question for C-FRESHNESS product deployment — a clean positive result justifies parallel-channel architecture for product, while a clean negative forces architectural pivot.

recommended_action: Re-run orthogonality on the existing production-like testbed with TWO corrections: (1) Fix V1 request_id entropy confound — use a single deterministic request_id generator (e.g., UUID v4) for ALL status codes (200, 304, 401, 403) independent of auth outcome, ensuring request_id entropy is identical across valid/expired token states. Alternatively, exclude request_id_entropy and dynamic_content_hash from the structural composite and use only ETag variation + Cache-Control variation as the structural signal. (2) Fix V2 B-FLASK-ONLY baseline degeneracy — add genuine token-state variation (valid/expired tokens via Authorization header or query param) to flask_only_server.py so behavioral_delta varies (std > 0) and Pearson r is computable. Both fixes are small code changes to testbed_server.py and flask_only_server.py. The frozen decision_rule C1-C6 can be reused. n>=480, delta=0.15. The testbed infrastructure (CDN simulation, 3 endpoints, 304 at 31.7%) is sound and reusable. After fixes, a clean positive result (|r|<0.15, TOST p_lower<0.05) would justify parallel-channel architecture for product deployment. A clean negative result would force architectural pivot.
